key_insight: AI Buckingham discovers dominant dimensionless groups and regime-dependent scaling laws by combining LLM-guided reasoning with symbolic and numerical tools.
engineering_relevance: The framework improves equivalent sand-grain roughness estimates through informative reparameterizations of surface statistics, supporting engineering-oriented turbulent drag modelling.
method: Use literature retrieval and symbolic tools to check dimensional consistency.
Identify physical regimes with gradient-based clustering and dominant dimensionless groups using mutual information.
Apply explicit numerical criteria to select group count and assess simplification.
evidence_signal: Across ten physical systems spanning fluid dynamics, magnetohydrodynamics, thermal convection and additive manufacturing, the framework recovers established similarity representations and resolves regime-dependent scalings.
watch_item: The abstract reports improved roughness estimates but provides no quantitative error reductions or details of out-of-sample validation.
paper_title: AI Buckingham: Agentic Discovery of Dimensionless Scaling Laws Across Physical Regimes
